core_obligations: Set up the filtration (proof lines 2334-2340): the author filters a K-injective representative of the given complex so that the associated graded pieces are the shifts of the cohomology sheaves of the direct image.
Identify the E_2 page and convergence (proof lines 2340-2344): the spectral sequence of that filtration has E_2^{p,q} = H^p(D, R^qf_*F^bullet) and converges to H^{p+q}(C, F^bullet), as asserted.
proof_roadmap: Filter a K-injective representative by its truncations.
Read the E_2 page of the resulting spectral sequence as the cohomology of the higher direct images.
Read off the convergence to the cohomology of the source.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the Leray spectral sequence for a morphism of ringed topoi and a bounded below complex, with E_2^{p,q} = H^p(D, R^qf_*F^bullet) converging to H^{p+q}(C, F^bullet) (statement lines 2322-2332). The proof filters a K-injective representative so that the graded pieces exhibit the cohomology sheaves of the direct image (proof lines 2334-2340) and reads off the E_2 page and the convergence (proof lines 2340-2344). The non-formal content is the choice of filtration. The claim is H2: one filtration and one page computation.
